text:
Carmen: Heads-up  I'm assembling the release notes and changelog bullets for the docs deploy on Monday. Main items: embeddings API param rename (input -> inputs), a new Go SDK example we want to include, and one stale internal anchor in the migration guide. Need quick owners so I can draft final copy.

Theo: I can own the snippets. CI caught the failing example: old JS example uses `client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: 'hello' })` -> 422 `\"invalid request shape\"`. Server expects `inputs: ['hello']` now. I'll prepare minimal JS, Python, and Go examples.

Ingrid: I'll do the redirect. LinkCheck flagged guides/migration/embeddings.md#legacy which should map to migration/embeddings-v4.md#legacy-embeddings. I'll update the docs link and add a _redirects.yaml entry.

Vega: Product wants the relnotes to be scannable: one bullet for user-facing change, one pointer to migration guide, and a known-issues line. Draft suggestion: "Embeddings: request payload is now 'inputs' (array) instead of 'input' (string). Update SDK calls accordingly. See Embeddings migration guide for examples and a quick diff. Known issue: some older SDKs may return 4xx when using legacy request shapes." Keep that?

Theo: That reads well. For examples I propose to show the old -> new one-line diff in the migration guide and only the final new snippets in the relnotes (JS + Go). Example (new):

```
// JS
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'rwd-embed-1',
  inputs: ['Here is my text']
});

// Go
resp, err := client.Embeddings.Create(ctx, &openai.EmbeddingsCreateParams{
  Model: "rwd-embed-1",
  Inputs: []string{"Here is my text"},
})
```

Ingrid: Redirect PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3122. Added mapping for the old anchor to migration/embeddings-v4.md#legacy-embeddings and updated the in-page link. Tagged infra for quick review.

linkcheck-bot: LinkCheck: scanned 482 pages, found 1 broken anchor -> guides/migration/embeddings.md#legacy (now fixed in PR #3122).

Carmen: Quick checklist: 
- Theo: snippet PR (JS + Python + Go) and add one-line diff in migration guide (assigned)
- Ingrid: redirect PR and update anchor in the guide (assigned)
- Vega: I'll draft the relnotes based on your suggested copy and post in #docs for signoff (assigned)

Theo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3123. Includes new snippets and a tiny diff in the migration guide showing `input: 'x'` -> `inputs: ['x']`. Also added a short changelog bullet under "Code samples".

Vega: Draft relnotes now posted in the release notes draft: "Embeddings: request payload changed to 'inputs' array. Update SDK usage to client.embeddings.create({ model, inputs }). See Embeddings migration guide for full examples. Known issue: pre-0.9 SDKs may return 4xx on legacy embed calls." Posting for quick review — will publish once both PRs merge.

Ingrid: Infra approved PR #3122; merging after CI completes. Note from infra: redirects merged after 07:00 UTC will be picked up in the next deploy window.

Theo: CI green on #3123, requested reviews. I ran `make linkcheck` and `./scripts/link-scanner` locally to sanity-check anchors.

Carmen: Thanks all. If anyone finds another stale anchor, run linkcheck and drop it here. I aim to finalize relnotes by 16:00 and publish. relnotes-bot: please remind on channel when both PRs are merged. :thumbsup:

relnotes-bot: Reminder scheduled: will ping at 16:05 if PRs merged.

Carmen: Final note for copy: we should avoid showing diffs in relnotes; keep diffs in migration guide. Relnotes should show the new final examples and the deprecation/known-issue lines only. Agreed?

Vega: Agreed. Short + actionable.

Carmen: Great, pairing complete. I'll post the relnotes draft link once merges are confirmed and request final signoff in #docs.
